function.name: statistics_calculate_p_value
function.description: Calculate the p-value for a t-test on a single sample from a population. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

sample_mean.description: The mean of the sample data. This is a float type value.

population_mean.description: The mean of the population data. This is a float type value.

sample_std_dev.description: The standard deviation of the sample data. This is a float type value.

sample_size.description: The size of the sample data.

two_tailed.description: Whether the test is two-tailed. If not provided, default is true.

message.reasoning: The user says: "計算樣本平均值為98.2、標準差為1.4、樣本大小為40的零假設檢定的標準差，以得到人口平均值為98.6。" They want to calculate something about hypothesis testing? They mention "零假設檢定的標準差" which might be "standard error" or "standard deviation of the sampling distribution"? They want to compute the standard deviation of the null hypothesis test? Actually they say "以得到人口平均值為98.6" meaning "to get population mean 98.6". So maybe they want to compute the p-value? But the question: "計算樣本平均值為98.2、標準差為1.4、樣本大小為40的零假設檢定的標準差，以得到人口平均值為98.6。" They want to compute the standard deviation of the null hypothesis test? That would be the standard error: sigma/sqrt(n). But we have sample standard deviation 1.4, but for null hypothesis we might use population standard deviation? But we don't know population sigma. We can approximate using sample std dev. So standard error = 1.4 / sqrt(40) = 1.4 / 6.3249 = 0.2215. So the standard deviation of the sampling distribution under null is 0.2215. Then maybe compute t-statistic: (98.2 - 98.6)/0.2215 = -0.4/0.2215 = -1.805. Then p-value two-tailed: 2 * P(T > |t|) with df=39. Use t distribution. Let's approximate: t=1.805, df=39. Using t table: For df=40, t=1.684 gives p=0.10; t=2.021 gives p=0.05. So t=1.805 gives p ~0.08. So p-value ~0.08. So answer: standard deviation of null test = 0.2215, t-statistic ~ -1.805, p-value ~0.08. Provide explanation. Use the function? The tool calculates p-value. We can call it. Provide arguments: sample_mean=98.2, population_mean=98.6, sample_std_dev=1.4, sample_size=40. two_tailed default true. Let's call.
